title: Get Playbook Result
description: Returns the playbook runlogs based on the unique ID of the playbook. If no payload is passed, it returns the complete list of playbook run logs.

query.name: page
query.description: Pass the page number to retrieve the playbook result.

query.name: page_size
query.description: Pass the number of items to retrieve per page.

query.name: playbook
query.description: Pass the playbook's unique ID. You can retrieve unique IDs of playbooks using the **Get Playbooks** endoint.

body.name: link
body.description: Returns the link to the previous and next page.

body.name: count
body.description: Returns the total number of playbook run logs.

body.name: results
body.description: Returns the list of playbook run logs.

items.name: unique_id
items.description: Returns the unique ID that is generated dynamically when a playbook runs.

items.name: created
items.description: Returns the date and time when the playbook was created.

items.name: modified
items.description: Returns the date and time when the playbook was last modified.

items.name: status
items.description: Returns the playbook run status.

items.name: source
items.description:
Returns the source that initiated the playbook run.
For example, *User*.

items.name: run_details
items.description: Returns the details of the user or event that executed the playbook.

items.name: cron_expression
items.description: Returns the cron string used for playbook scheduling.

items.name: playbook_data
items.description: Returns the details of the playbook.

items.description: Returns the unique ID that is generated dynamically on playbook creation.

items.name: categories
items.description: Returns the list of categories associated with the playbook. These are categories associated with playbooks in Orchestrate > Manage Playbook > App Store.

items.name: status

items.name: apps_count

items.name: app_action
